subject: Post-call: discovery recap + meeting link rotated (next steps)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Peter Lowe <p.lowe@atlashealth.io>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: discovery recap + meeting link rotated (next steps)

Hi Alex / Peter —

Thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: low-latency inference for clinical note summarization (~1–2s token latency target), strict data isolation, and an audit trail for model prompts.
- Platform fit: Redwood Dedicated looks like the right path initially (reserved capacity + VPC). We'll validate latency on your 512-token workflows.
- Action items (mine): share discovery notes and the SOC2 checklist you requested; propose technical deep-dive slots with Ben (infrastructure lead).

Two notes on scheduling: I see the calendar invite we sent earlier had a rotated meeting URL — several users at Atlas reported the link pointed to a stale bridge. If you didn’t receive a working link, that’s on us and sorry for the friction.

Proposed deep-dive windows (PT):
- Mon 6/8: 10:00–10:45 PT (Ben + infra + short perf run)
- Tue 6/9: 08:30–09:15 PT (alternate, earlier slot)

If neither works, please send 2x preferred windows and I’ll align. I’ve attached my discovery notes and the SOC2 questions PDF you asked for.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: discovery-notes-SoS.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-questions.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Brown <alex@atlashealth.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: discovery recap + meeting link rotated (next steps)

Hey Soojin —

Thanks for the recap and the docs. Apologies — I didn't get the working link earlier, just the stale bridge you mentioned. Peter and I both ended up waiting on the old URL. We're still very interested.

Either of those slots could work for us, but we have a clinic demo at 10:30 PT on Monday that might run long. Would it be possible to push Monday to 11:00–11:45 PT or keep Tue 08:30 PT as a fallback? Also, can Ben confirm if a short perf test (10 minutes) against a quantized 7B variant is feasible during the call?

Couple quick asks:
- We prefer Zoom for the deep-dive if possible (security/compliance team is strict about bridges).
- Can you share a one-page checklist of what we should have ready for the perf test?

Thanks — Alex
Director of Data Platforms, Atlas Health
alex@atlashealth.io | +1 (617) 555-0114

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex@atlashealth.io>, Peter Lowe <p.lowe@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: discovery recap + meeting link rotated (next steps)

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging Zoom. Looping in Ben + Monica to confirm technical feasibility + logistics.

Ben/Monica: short ask — can we run a 10-minute perf probe against a quantized 7B model during the deep-dive? Atlas would supply a 512-token representative prompt and a small sample of inputs (non-PHI). They want to see token latency and memory footprint. Also, can we host the session on Zoom as requested (we can provide a secure meeting link and invite)?

I’ve tentatively adjusted the Monday slot to 11:00–11:45 PT and left Tue 08:30 PT as the alternate. If either is a hard constraint for Atlas, let me know and I’ll rebook.

Operational checklist for a smooth perf probe (one-pager attached):
- Representative prompt(s) and input sample (non-PHI)
- A single user account with API key (test, limited scope)
- Preferred endpoint configuration (max tokens, temperature, top_p)
- Expected throughput target (tokens/sec) and latency SLO

Ben — if you can confirm the perf plan and whether a brief kernel-level trace is feasible, I’ll lock the invite and send Zoom details.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachment: discovery-notes-SoS.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alex Brown <alex@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: discovery recap + meeting link rotated (next steps)

Hi all —

Confirmed: we can run a 10-minute perf probe during the deep-dive against a quantized 7B. Plan:
- 5 minutes to validate the Zoom bridge and ensure network egress to our test infra.
- 10 minutes perf probe: Atlas provides 10 representative prompts (non-PHI). We'll run sequential requests at your nominal pacing to measure median and p95 token latency.
- Optional: we can capture a brief kernel timeline and KV cache stats (no PHI captured).

I’ll provide a secure Zoom link when Soojin locks the calendar. For the invite rotation — we’ll make sure the URL published in the body matches the calendar event (I’ll verify twice).

See you Monday 11:00–11:45 PT unless Alex prefers Tue 08:30 PT.

Ben Carter
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---
On a related note: Monica — can you drop the SOC2 evidence bundle we discussed into the shared drive before the call? Alex, I’ll make sure the perf probe only uses sanitized inputs.
